questions.def: In reported speech, we usually shift the tense back one step.
questions.question: She said she ___ to go home.

questions.def: Past continuous in reported speech reflects continuous action in the past.
questions.question: He told me he ___ a new car.

questions.def: Past perfect is used when reporting past actions before another past action.
questions.question: He said he ___ all the cake.

questions.def: Present simple 'are' becomes past simple 'were' in reported speech.
questions.question: They said they ___ happy to be here.

questions.def: 'If' introduces reported yes/no questions.
questions.question: I asked him ___ he liked pizza.

questions.def: Yesterday becomes past perfect in indirect speech.
questions.question: He told me he ___ to the store yesterday.

questions.def: 'Is' changes to 'was' in reported speech.
questions.question: She said she ___ tired.

questions.def: 'Is' changes to 'was' even with 'going to'.
questions.question: He said he ___ going to the party.

questions.def: Last night also uses the past perfect in reported speech.
questions.question: He said he ___ a movie last night.

questions.def: Reported question uses statement word order.
questions.question: She asked me what ___ my name was.

questions.def: Present simple 'speaks' becomes past simple 'spoke'.
questions.question: He told me that he ___ English.

questions.def: Yesterday becomes past perfect in reported speech.
questions.question: He asked me what I ___ yesterday.

questions.def: Simple past is used when reporting simple past events.
questions.question: They said they ___ to the beach.

questions.def: Present simple 'likes' becomes past simple 'liked'.
questions.question: He said he ___ the movie.

questions.def: Past action before reporting uses past perfect.
questions.question: He said he ___ hard.

questions.def: 'Will' changes to 'would' in reported speech.
questions.question: He said he ___ be late.

questions.def: 'Where' introduces reported 'where' questions.
questions.question: She asked me ___ I was going.

questions.def: Past action before reporting uses past perfect.
questions.question: She said she ___ dinner.

questions.def: 'Cannot' changes to 'could not' in reported speech.
questions.question: They said they ___ come to the party.

questions.def: Past continuous in reported speech.
questions.question: She said that she ___ a good time.

questions.def: Past action before reporting uses past perfect.
questions.question: He said he ___ in London.

questions.def: 'Is going' changes to 'was going' in reported speech.
questions.question: He said he ___ to the gym.

questions.def: 'If' introduces reported yes/no questions.
questions.question: She asked me ___ I needed help.

questions.def: In reported speech, 'said' requires past simple tense.
questions.question: She said she ___ to the park yesterday.

questions.def: Past simple changes to past perfect after 'told me'.
questions.question: He told me he ___ a new car.

questions.def: Past simple changes to past perfect after 'said'.
questions.question: He said he ___ all the cake.

questions.def: 'Are' changes to 'were' in reported speech when reporting past events.
questions.question: They said they ___ happy to be here.

questions.def: Use 'if' or 'whether' to report yes/no questions.
questions.question: I asked him ___ he liked the movie.

questions.def: 'Will go' changes to 'would go' in reported speech.
questions.question: She told me she ___ to Italy the next year.

questions.def: 'Am' changes to 'was' in reported speech.
questions.question: He said he ___ tired.
